name: openecraft
description: Electrical CAE: draw schematics, assign parts, run the check, export reports, PDF, SVG and DXF.
long_description: OpenECraft is an open source electrical CAE editor (device-oriented schematics, reports, panel layout in 3D). This extension runs its MCP server: the agent creates and opens projects, places symbols, connects pins by device tag (-K1:A1), assigns parts, runs the project check and writes reports and PDF / SVG / DXF exports. The projects open in the OpenECraft editor, on the desktop or at editor.openecraft.org. The server works offline; it talks to a parts server, the EPLAN Data Portal or Autodesk Vault only when asked to connect to one.

projects.title: Projects folder
projects.description: The only folder the agent may read and write projects, exports and reports in. Ask for absolute paths in it.

tools.title: Tools (optional)
tools.description: Comma separated tool names to offer; empty offers the tools for schematics and find_tools / call_tool for the others, * all of them (over 440). parts_* stands for all tools starting with parts_.
